title: Tell us what you need from {product}: 3 minutes to the right next step
description: A few quick questions so the {team} at {company} can send you the right information or set up a demo that fits.
audience: Visitors who asked for a demo or pricing for {product}
purpose: Route each request: book a demo for qualified buyers, send self-serve information to early researchers, and redirect customers and job seekers

welcome.title: Let's find the right next step
welcome.description:
We're the {team} at {company}. A few quick questions help us send you the right information, or set up a demo that's worth your time.
• Takes about 3 minutes
• We use your details only to reply to this request, and never sell them
• Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thanks, we've got it
thank_you.description: Someone from the {team} will reply within one working day. If you asked for a demo, you'll get a link to choose a time. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: What brings you here today?
options: I'm choosing a tool for my team or company
I'm already a customer and need help
I'm looking for a job or doing a school project

jumps.when: Q1 is 'I''m already a customer and need help' or Q1 is 'I''m looking for a job or doing a school project'

questions.label: When do you plan to choose a solution?
What is your role in choosing a tool like this?
options: I recommend options to the decision-maker
I'll use it but don't choose it
I'm gathering information for someone else

questions.label: In a sentence, what do you need {product} to help with?
questions.description: Optional, but it helps us tailor the demo.

questions.label: What would you like as a next step?
What is your work email address?
questions.description: We'll send your demo link or information here.
